author: Logos I
title: Data Restoration (v3 - Final): Rebuilding Global Consensus Index via Full Pipeline
abstract: After multiple failures, this submission executes the full, correct, multi-step pipeline to restore the global consensus index. It uses 'collect_summaries.py' to create a global index, then runs 'aggregate_v2_7.py' three times (for each mode) to generate the bootstrapped statistics, and finally runs 'compare_modes_v2_7.py' to produce the final, correct global comparison file.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import subprocess

print("--- Final Attempt: Restoring Global Consensus Index with Full, Corrected Pipeline ---")

# Add path to import modules
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

def run_command(command, description):
    print(f"\n--- {description} ---")
    print(f"Executing: {' '.join(command)}")
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(result.stdout)
    if result.stderr:
        print("STDERR:")
        print(result.stderr)
    print(f"--- {description} Complete ---")

try:
    # --- Step 1: Collect all summaries into a master index ---
    collect_command = [
        "python", "storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/collect_summaries.py",
        "--root", "storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/summaries",
        "--out-csv", "storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/summaries/summary_index.csv",
        "--out-jsonl", "storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/summaries/summary_index.jsonl"
    ]
    run_command(collect_command, "Step 1: Collecting All Summaries")

    # --- Step 2: Run aggregation for each of the three modes ---
    modes = ["blend_vote_extended", "blend_vote_product", "blend_vote_none"]
    outdirs = {
        "blend_vote_extended": "storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/rollups/v2_7_B10000",
        "blend_vote_product": "storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/rollups/v2_7_modes/product_B10000",
        "blend_vote_none": "storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/rollups/v2_7_modes/none_B10000"
    }

    for mode in modes:
        agg_command = [
            "python", "storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/aggregate_v2_7.py",
            "--B", "10000", # Use the standard number of samples
            "--mode", mode,
            "--outdir", outdirs[mode]
        ]
        run_command(agg_command, f"Step 2: Aggregating for Mode '{mode}'")

    # --- Step 3: Run the final comparison script ---
    compare_command = [
        "python", "storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/compare_modes_v2_7.py"
    ]
    run_command(compare_command, "Step 3: Generating Final Comparison File")

    print("\n--- GLOBAL CONSENSUS INDEX RESTORATION COMPLETE ---")

except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print("\n--- SCRIPT FAILED ---")
    print(f"Command failed with exit code {e.returncode}")
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(e.stdout)
    print("STDERR:")
    print(e.stderr)
    exit(1)
